title: Banding the Ceiling on One Grant Period by How the Account Has Been Eating
content:
The ceiling an allowance lot on an Employee Meal Account is held to for one grant period is banded on how often allowance has lately been applied and on how many meals of the employee's own have been rung. The heavy use share is 150 percent and the light use share is 60 percent.

**Clause.** Where allowance has been applied on the account on two or more occasions in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and four or more meals of the employee's own have been rung on it in that same month, the grant period ceiling is the printed grant ceiling taken at the heavy use share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where allowance has been applied on fewer than two occasions in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and four or more meals of the employee's own have been rung on it in that same month, the grant period ceiling is the printed grant ceiling taken at the light use share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, the grant period ceiling is the grant ceiling printed against the plan.

## The bands

| Occasions allowance was applied in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Meals of the employee's own rung in that month | The grant period ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4 or more | 150 percent of the grant ceiling printed against the plan |
| Fewer than 2, including none | 4 or more | 60 percent of that printed grant ceiling |
| Any number | Fewer than 4 | The grant ceiling printed against the plan |

## Points of judgement

Both bands require four or more meals of the employee's own in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked; an account with three such meals takes the printed ceiling however often allowance has been applied to it. The two bands then divide on the count of allowance applications in that same month, at two.

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan printing a grant ceiling of $9.50 for one grant period, an account with 3 allowance applications and 6 meals of the employee's own in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked carries a ceiling of $14.25; with 1 application and the same 6 meals it carries $5.70; with 6 applications and 2 meals it carries $9.50.
